summary: Single global setter: writes argument a1 into the module global dword_8B8E4C and returns a1 unchanged. Called from the video-manager init and post paths (VidMan_Init, VidMan_Post); the global's downstream purpose is not established by this packet.

operations.description: Copy the argument into the result register: result = a1.
Write a1 into the global dword_8B8E4C (0x008B8E4C), the only side effect of this setter.
Return result, i.e. the stored value a1.
